description: The full recorded story of one change in an ad account, for 'why did you do that?', 'who changed X?', 'what happened with the budget change on…': what started it (an engine check, the daily review, a plan branch and its condition, a chat request, the owner, or someone outside Taseli), the numbers it was based on at the time, the owner's rules in force, the playbook rules and similar-business results it cited, the platform's dry run, who approved it, when and how, the run and its read-back, the watch and verdict, and what Taseli learned. Built from Taseli's records, not reconstructed. It covers one change; why a number moved is answered by the account review. Read only.

about.description: The change in the person's own words, any language, e.g. 'the budget change on Summer sale yesterday' or 'who paused the brand campaign'.

account.description: An ad account's name, when it is about one account only; omit when it is about the whole business.

change.description: The change's id (a decision id, the page or a link) or its number, e.g. '#12'. Omit when you only have words.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: explain_change

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Why a change was made
